reviews.text: I shop for my cat’s food and needs here and the service is consistently excellent. They have membership discounts, and the prices are so much better than most places.
All your needs! Pet safe ingredients! Great self wash for dogs in the back of the store!

Love this place! The reoccurring food order is so helpful to me because I never have to worry about my Matzah running out. He also loves his blue sling bag, very comfy for the both of us. Love that each time I’m purchasing litter for my Ruby, it goes toward a free bag, eventually. Recently fostered a dog named Lola and was able to walk in and out with a necessary collar. I love supporting a small business and tell a lot of my clients/friends to visit! Cute pet sweaters, wide selection of cat and dog dishes, water fountains, carriers, birthday treats, individual treats, toys, vitamins, diets, etc. You name it, they most likely have it! Friendly staff, clean store, large parking lot. See y’all next time.

I visited The Urban Pet and had an excellent experience shopping for pet supplies. The store had a welcoming atmosphere and an impressive selection of products for dogs, cats, birds, reptiles, and other small animals. Everything was neatly organized, making it easy to browse and find exactly what I needed.

What stood out most was the quality and variety of pet food, treats, toys, and accessories available. The staff were knowledgeable and happy to provide recommendations based on my pet's needs. Their genuine passion for animals made the shopping experience feel more personal than a typical retail store.

The store was clean, well-stocked, and pet-friendly, creating a comfortable environment for both pets and owners. I also appreciated the additional services and community involvement that help make it a trusted destination for local pet owners.

Overall, The Urban Pet is a fantastic place for pet lovers looking for quality products, helpful service, and a welcoming atmosphere. I would definitely return for future pet supplies and recommendations.

I visited The Urban Pet while in Los Angeles, and it was a really pleasant stop. I was looking for a local pet store with quality supplies, and this place had a much better selection than many larger chain stores. It felt like a neighborhood shop that focuses on carefully chosen products rather than simply filling shelves.

The first thing I noticed was how organized everything was. There were sections for food, toys, treats, grooming products, and accessories, and it was easy to browse without feeling crowded. The store carried items that looked thoughtfully selected, including some brands and products I don’t usually see in bigger pet retailers. That made it more interesting, especially if you’re shopping for something specific.

The staff were one of the best parts of the visit. They were friendly and genuinely knowledgeable. I had a few questions about treats and food options, and they took time to explain differences without making it feel like a sales pitch. That kind of help is valuable because pet products can vary a lot, and it’s nice when someone actually understands what they’re selling.

The shop itself was clean, bright, and welcoming. I saw several customers come in with their dogs, which added to the relaxed atmosphere. It felt like a place that regular pet owners trust and return to often. The staff greeted both customers and pets warmly, which made the experience feel personal.

I ended up buying a few treats and a toy, and the quality seemed worth the price. What stood out most was the customer service and the attention to product quality. It felt like they care about helping people find the right items for their pets.

If you’re in Los Angeles, CA and want a local pet store with good selection and helpful staff, The Urban Pet is worth checking out. I’d definitely return next time I’m in the area and need pet supplies.
